state: Four Report landing images completed; four matching In progress images not submitted because returned model differs from requested model.

approaches.name: Clean folders
approaches.art: ART DIRECTION SET 1 — CLEAN FOLDERS. Most restrained and orderly approach. Compact header, modest facility carousel occupying about 18% of screen height. Folder assembly starts around 34% screen height and dominates the rest above bottom nav. Thin wine borders, generous vanilla space, quiet sand folder backs, very few decorative folds. Main sheet resembles a neatly indexed office file reinterpreted in precise stepped pixel geometry. Clearly spaced full-width form fields with small left-aligned labels. High legibility and visual calm, selected top tab gold. Keep the carousel centred, selected playground medium size with two small neighbours. Elegant editorial hierarchy within playful pixel stationery.

approaches.name: Pixel stationery
approaches.art: ART DIRECTION SET 2 — PIXEL STATIONERY. Noticeably expressive tactile paper-folder composition using flat pixels rather than realism. Bold stair-step folder contours, stronger wine hard offset shadows, tiny cherry folded-corner details, a small report-icon sticker by the form heading. Sand backing sheets peek behind vanilla active sheet, top tabs have playful staggered positions but remain readable and usable. Header compact, carousel moderate 20% height with a gold stepped selection frame around centre playground. Folder begins about 35% height, form remains spacious enough to write. A narrow sand header band inside the sheet carries facility context; the rest is quiet vanilla. Decorative charm comes from silhouettes and layering, no paper textures, gradients, doodle clutter or additional colours.

approaches.name: Facility first
approaches.art: ART DIRECTION SET 3 — FACILITY FIRST. Facility carousel is the visual centrepiece in the top third: larger angled top-down pixel playground scene in a wide outlined vanilla display window, small neighbour previews tucked left/right and obvious arrow controls. Selected name Playground prominent below illustration, Block A smaller. Header and Reports title compact. Folder assembly begins about 43% screen height. Compact form with readable narrow-font descriptions, shorter but usable description area, photo as compact single row and full-width gold Send report button. Four folder top labels follow a clean stepped skyline. The folder must still show every field and submit action above nav. This option should feel like choosing a place first then completing its file. Clear balanced graphical hierarchy rather than the same layout as clean folders.

approaches.name: Reports first
approaches.art: ART DIRECTION SET 4 — REPORTS FIRST. Very compact facility strip below Reports title, about 12-14% of screen height: small selected playground icon, clear Playground / Block A name, tiny neighbours and arrows. Folder assembly starts near 26% screen height and fills most of screen. Broad vanilla active sheet with large comfortable writing area, generous Description field, photo attachment area and gold action. Strong filing-cabinet organisation: crisp sand top-index tabs, clear gold active tab, restrained wine dividers. Only small hard shadows. Minimal illustration dominance, strong readable content hierarchy, subtle little file reference motif by section header. This must be visibly a different content-heavy composition, not merely recolouring the other options.

Create one polished full-screen mobile web app UI concept for KoBi — Komuniti Bijak, a friendly civic facility reporting app. One single straight-on portrait 9:16 screen, edge-to-edge app artwork, no phone bezel, no perspective, no collage, no design presentation annotations. Crisp legible English UI. Typography: Bungee for titles, folder tabs and all buttons; Yanone Kaffeesatz regular/bold for field labels, inputs, dates, body copy and status. UI flat fills use ONLY wine #6C1A21, cherry #B92C2C, gold #CEA257, sand #D1BF9A, vanilla #E5E0CD. Wine ink/outlines, vanilla main surfaces, sand context/inactive surfaces, gold selection/main action, tiny cherry folded corners. No gradients, blur shadows, rounded pills, green status or blue UI. Pixel Stickers style: controlled stepped corners, thin wine outlines, small hard offset shadows, a warm 16-bit civic toolkit; keep typing areas simple and calm. Pixel facility illustration may be illustrated but use the same limited palette for visual coherence. 

SHARED SCREEN STRUCTURE: Header with small KoBi wordmark on left, hamburger menu on right, small persistent Demo mode notice. Page title Reports. Above the folders a facility-selection carousel with left/right arrow buttons, selected pixel-art playground facility in centre and smaller cropped neighbouring facility previews at sides. Selected facility live label 'Playground' and smaller location 'Block A'. This is a FACILITY carousel, not report categories. Bottom navigation Map / Reports / Activities / Profile with Reports active gold. No coins, shop, game economy, profile hero or New report button.

MAIN FOLDER CONSTRUCTION: Four real file-folder silhouettes ordered Report, Received, In progress, Resolved. Broad calm folder body, protruding top-index label physically joined to its sheet. Each sheet has TWO labels, one horizontal on top and a second on its RIGHT edge, with the second label's word rotated 90 degrees. These are two labels on a physical sliding sheet, not one label that rotates. In the landing state the FIRST folder Report is open. Four horizontal top labels visible in a compact staggered row or at two heights, Report gold selected, Received / In progress / Resolved sand, wine lettering. All label words fully legible; 'In progress' may take two lines. Other sheets subtly layered behind the open form. NO vertical labels on the left in this initial state.

ACTIVE REPORT FOLDER CONTENT: heading 'Report a problem', context 'Playground · Block A', simple full-width field 'Problem title' with example 'Broken swing seat'; 'Description' multiline field with 'One swing seat is damaged and cannot be used safely.'; compact optional photo area labelled 'Photo (optional)' and camera icon with 'Add photo'. Large gold ticket-shaped 'Send report' button after fields. Small honest caption 'Demo only · Saved on this browser'. All content fits visibly, natural mobile composition, no oversized decorative hero sacrificing form space. Retain breathing room, readable fields, obvious selected facility.
